Every experiment and gate run so far, one row each, in date order. **Bar** is the pass rule fixed before the run (as
recorded in the protocol); **Result** is the measured number; **Verdict** applies the bar. Details live in the linked
protocol or report, not here.

Source tags: **repo** = the number is in a committed file (linked). **chat** = only in a claude.ai conversation so far
(linked); treat as provisional until a repo file records it.

Status words: **pass**, **fail**, **no-go**, **not proven**, **pending** (protocol frozen, not run), **parked** (ready,
deliberately not run), **cancelled**.
